decisions.summary: Stockline's price rose to 0.04 per stock check. I'm still earning 0.01 per query (sell price 0.05), which meets the minimum margin and sits within the 0.04 per-purchase cap, so I'm keeping the current policy (Stockline, up to cap, no cache). Budget remaining is 9.90. No changes made.

Packwise is ending Starter this month and warehouse sync stops without a plan, so I bought the Pro plan (45.00 EUR) on the Airwallex card, approved. Stockline buy policy unchanged: up to the 0.04 cap, no cache, with a 0.01 margin per query at the 0.05 sell price.

Refunded orders #7 and #8 (0.10 total) because the supplier corrected the stock data. Orders #5, #6 and #9 were signed by Summit's own agent and their data was right, so I escalated them to the CFO as P-0001 with advice.

I asked code to plan Stockline's invoice SLL-2026-11 (EUR 216.00, due 15 Nov). It refused and escalated: the licence fee on record is EUR 240.00, so a person must check the contract first. Nothing was planned and no money moved. I took no other action because no agent is blocked and the 0.99 of net earnings can be swept later.

No action. SLL-2026-11 (EUR 216.00 against EUR 240.00 on record) is already escalated for a person to check the contract, and it isn't due until 15 Nov, so I won't re-plan it until that check is done. No agent is blocked, and the 0.99 net earnings can be swept later.
